blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) has launched an investigation to determine the administrative liability of two police officers whose government-issued firearms were stolen from their parked car while they were at a beach resort here over the weekend. The officers, who are assigned to Police Station 10 in Barangay Cugman, fell victim to a “basag-kotse” (car break-in) incident at Raagas Beach in Barangay Bonbon at around 6:00 p.m. on Saturday, October 17.
